Table~\ref{tab:hands-announced} carries the columns of Table~\ref{tab:hands-available} plus the date of the claim and the class of artefact it was read off, over the same eight specification columns. Its empty share is far higher, and that is the finding of the table rather than a defect of it: an unreleased hand is announced without a specification. \emph{evidence} is \emph{datasheet} for a paper, datasheet or vendor specification page, \emph{video} for a demonstration reel, \emph{press} for a press release or a third-party tracker. \emph{claim date} prints \emph{undated} where the source page carries no date of its own; a fetch date is not a claim date.
